description:
Lot of 5 Vintage Glass Electrical Insulators Hemingray Blue Green Clear
This lot includes 5 vintage glass electrical insulators featuring both aqua/blue-green and clear glass varieties. Two blue-green insulators are marked with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. Each insulator is made of heavy, thick glass with a classic double-groove design. Most pieces exhibit signs of age including minor dirt, residue, and surface wear but have no major cracks or chips visible. The clear glass insulators include one with a partial label and some with embossed markings. These insulators were originally used on telegraph and power lines and are suitable for collectors or as decorative industrial items.
9 x 8 x 4 in

description:

Contents unknown.

Condition: Used display condition. Light surface soil and small speckles on the white pieces, tarnish and spotting on the silver tone band and gold tone barrel. Labels worn.

description:
Hemingray Glass Insulators Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray Glass Company, No. 17 and Patent 1893 Models
Aqua Blue and Clear, Vintage 19th to 20th Century
This collection features three vintage glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. These utilitarian pieces were originally designed to support telegraph and telephone wires, and are now highly sought after for their iconic industrial aesthetic and diverse color variations.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua Blue glass, marked "HEMINGRAY" and "PATENT MAY 2 1893," featuring sharp drip points on the base edge.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Condition:
The aqua blue insulator shows significant internal soot or carbon deposits and surface grime from authentic outdoor service. The clear insulators show minor surface wear and occasional internal bubbles characteristic of molded utility glass. No significant structural cracks are observed, though minor fleabites consistent with industrial usage may be present along the base edges.

Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Vintage Lot of 4 Smoking Pipes Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Hardwood Wood
This lot includes four vintage smoking pipes: two Missouri Meerschaum corn cob pipes (one with a yellow stem, one with a black stem), a Missouri Meerschaum Hardwood pipe with light brown finish and labeled stem, and a large ornately turned wooden pipe with a brass lid on the bowl. Pipe colors range from natural wood tones to yellow and dark brown. Stems include amber and black plastic. Sizes vary from small to extra-large, with the largest pipe featuring intricate carved details. All pipes show signs of use and wear consistent with age. Suitable for collectors or display.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of calligraphy and fountain pen supplies and sets, including Western and Chinese calligraphy kits. The collection features Sheaffer Calligraphy Classic sets with pens, colored ink cartridges, and nibs. Also included are Chinese calligraphy gift boxes with brushes, ink stones, ceramic brush rests, ink sticks, and porcelain water dishes. There are loose calligraphy and fountain pens from brands such as Preppy and Brause, as well as additional pen nibs and accessories. Materials represented include plastic, metal, wood, and ceramic.

Specifications:
- Includes calligraphy and fountain pen sets and supplies
- Sheaffer Calligraphy Classic sets with pens, cartridges, and nibs
- Chinese calligraphy kits with brushes, ink stones, brush rests, ink sticks, water dishes
- Loose pens from various brands including Preppy and Brause
- Additional pen nibs and accessories
- Materials: plastic, metal, wood, ceramic
- Total lot weight: 8 pounds

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

German Hunter Style Tobacco Pipe

Century Classic - Chrome Silver-Tone
Vintage, 2 Piece Set with Presentation Box
This classic Cross Century writing set includes a matched ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, exemplifying the sleek, minimalist design that defined professional stationary in the late 20th century. Established in 1846, the A.T. Cross Company is renowned for its iconic conical top and pinstripe barrel textures. This set features the high-polish chrome finish with a vertical engine-turned line pattern, offering a timeless aesthetic and balanced writing weight.
Verified "CROSS USA" stamp on the cap of each piece
Classic Century pinstripe design with iconic black conical tops
Set includes: 1 twist-action ballpoint pen and 1 twist-action mechanical pencil
Original green and gold presentation box included

Twist mechanisms for both the pen and pencil are intact with no visible damage. The presentation box shows light external storage wear but remains structurally sound.

Two large hollow geodes featuring dense white quartz crystal formations, measuring approximately 5-6 inches each
Three fossilized Mosasaurus teeth in original display case from Morocco, dating to the Late Cretaceous period

Natural Agate Geode Slice Set
Polished Stone with Copper Foil Edging
6.5" x 5.5"

This collection of six natural agate geode slices showcases a sophisticated array of geological formations, featuring intricate banding and crystalline centers in a palette of warm ochre, sienna, and translucent cream. Four specimens are enhanced with a hand-applied copper foil perimeter, a technique that provides a modern, metallic contrast to the organic, rugged textures of the stone's exterior. The slices demonstrate characteristic chalcedony layering and varied mineral density, typical of high-quality volcanic geodes.
Set includes four copper-foiled slices and two natural specimens with varied finishes
Translucent centers exhibit excellent light transmission, revealing fine internal structures
Ideal for use as decorative coasters, display specimens, or lapidary art bases
Largest piece measures approximately 6.5" x 5.5" x 1"
